name: filmhub-fullstack
description: FilmHub - 3D movie blog and community platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: set PORT=5202&& set CLIENT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5275&& npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.dev:client: set VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5202/api&& npm run dev --workspace client -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5275 --strictPort
